text.arabic_uthmani: وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱرْجُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْءَاخِرَ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

baseline.text: Medyen'e de kardeşleri Şuayb'ı gönderdik. O, "Ey halkım! Allah'a kulluk edin, ahiret gününü umut edin ve yeryüzünde bozgunculuk yaparak karışıklık çıkarmayın" dedi.

findings.text: Şuayb'ın “kardeşleri” diye tanıtılması, uyarıyı dışarıdan gelen bir saldırı değil, toplumsal bağın içinden yapılan bir onarım girişimi haline getirir.
Ahiret gününü umut etmek, yakın çıkarın ufku bütünüyle kaplamasını önleyerek yeryüzüne yayılan bozgunculuğu dizginleyen zamansal bir yöneliştir.

activation_trace.role: Kinship and relatedness place the speaker inside the social body he is trying to repair.
Voiced speech turns the kin relation into an explicit corrective intervention.
The gathered-people image supplies the collective addressee whose shared practice can be repaired.

changed_reading.after: A community insider uses kin speech to reconnect worship, temporal expectation, and public conduct as one communal repair.
changed_reading.before: A messenger gives a people three adjacent religious and moral commands.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "their brother ... he said ... O my people" at words 3, 5, and 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speaker enters as kin, addresses a constituted people, and couples worship and future hope with a ban on destructive land-action. Kinship makes the warning an internal act of communal repair rather than an external denunciation.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience supplies the present allegiance from which conduct is ordered.
The heart's reaching toward what is hoped for makes futurity an active motive rather than a date label.
The image of a momentous event gives the hoped-for day decisive evaluative pressure.
What comes after the first horizon extends evaluation beyond the immediate present.

changed_reading.after: Worship and active expectation install a future accountability horizon inside present land-use and social conduct.
changed_reading.before: The verse asks for worship, belief in an afterlife, and good behavior.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated imperatives "worship God" and "hope for the Last Day" at words 7-11.
baseline_models.mechanism: Submissive worship fixes present allegiance while heartfelt expectation fixes conduct to a later and decisive horizon. The prohibition that follows is therefore governed by more than immediate advantage.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground beneath human action supplies the concrete shared domain on which damage lands.
The soft productive earth image makes the affected domain capable of growth and therefore vulnerable to impairment.
Exit from soundness and balance defines the prohibited action as system-degrading rather than merely disorderly.

changed_reading.after: The closing clause is a systems-integrity warning: do not make destructive movement through a shared, productive ground into a settled mode of life.
changed_reading.before: The closing clause is a broad ban on wicked behavior.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "do not ta'thaw in the earth as corrupters" at words 12-16.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branchless focus verb supplies uncontrolled destructive action, while earth supplies the grounded field affected and corruption names departure from sound order. The participial ending makes corruption a practiced mode that the prohibition seeks to stop before it becomes identity.

activation_trace.role: Heartfelt expectation anchors the delta in the focus command to hope.
Assaying metal or persons supplies the mechanism by which a spoken claim becomes tested quality.
Fulfilled promise and deed make truth visible as enacted reliability.
Guaranteeing another's load exposes the false offer of transferred moral liability.
Weight against lightness gives consequences non-evadable load.
Questioning and demand convert the future day into an accounting encounter.

changed_reading.after: Hope means living so the claim survives assay, because neither group belonging nor another's promise can carry one's eventual account.
changed_reading.before: Hope for the Last Day is chiefly assent to a future event shared by the people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening test sequence turns professed expectation into something assayed in action, while the burden sequence denies social transfer of liability and ends in questioning on the resurrection day. The focus address to a people remains collective, but its hoped-for horizon penetrates collective cover and reaches each bearer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, enacted truth, failed burden-transfer, and future questioning; I infer that the focus hope is a discipline of answerability that defeats communal cover. A live alternative is that these are separate warnings about sincerity and influence rather than one accountability mechanism.
structural_cues: 29:2-3 moves from saying "we believe" through testing to the disclosure of truth and falsehood.
29:12-13 moves from an offered transfer of errors to actual burdens and questioning on the resurrection day.

activation_trace.role: The focus heart-orientation supplies the command whose temporal force is sharpened.
Repeated heartfelt expectation explicitly connects hope with meeting God.
Two things converging face-to-face make futurity an encounter rather than an abstraction.
A fixed temporal limit gives the hoped-for encounter a bounded horizon.

changed_reading.after: The Last Day is an approaching encounter with a set limit, so hope compresses future answerability into present restraint.
changed_reading.before: The Last Day is a distant object of hope.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same hope-root is attached to meeting God, then bounded by an appointed term. Convergence and deadline turn the focus imperative from indefinite optimism into orientation toward an encounter already moving toward completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated hope, encounter, and deadline; I infer that a coming boundary exerts present behavioral pressure. The alternative is to retain hope as affective longing without importing deadline logic into the focus prohibition.
structural_cues: 29:5 repeats the focus hope-root and immediately asserts that God's appointed term is coming.
29:36 places hope directly before the prohibition on corruptive action.

activation_trace.role: Humble obedience anchors provision-seeking in the focus allegiance command.
Departure from sound order is the focus outcome that the provision regime may prevent.
Possession and power of disposal expose the inability of alternative objects of worship to control provision.
Apportioned giving identifies provision as received share rather than autonomous capture.
Recognizing gift and giver converts acquisition into gratitude.
Holding the self against panic supplies temporal endurance under pressure.
Reliant entrustment supplies the active alternative to anxious self-securing.
Sustaining food extends the provider relation even to creatures that do not carry their own supply.
Expansion and increase show one side of provision's variable distribution.
Restriction to a narrow measure supplies the other side without transferring providerhood.

changed_reading.after: Worship reorganizes dependence and provision-seeking, creating the trust needed to refuse destructive self-securing under scarcity or abundance.
changed_reading.before: Worship and avoiding corruption are adjacent but largely separate obligations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah relocates provision from objects that cannot control it to God's apportioned gift, gratitude, patient reliance, and variable expansion or restriction. Read back into the focus, worship establishes the provider relation while hope makes reliance durable; corruptive action is no longer justified as the only way to secure one's share.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dependence, allotment, gratitude, endurance, and variable provision; I infer that perceived resource pressure can feed corruptive action and that trust interrupts that arrow. The live alternative is that provision consolation and the focus prohibition remain parallel rather than causally linked.
structural_cues: 29:17 sequences inability to possess provision, seeking it with God, worship, and gratitude.
29:59-62 sequences patience and reliance with creatures' provision and its expansion or restriction.

activation_trace.role: Productive soft earth anchors the changed reading in a focus domain capable of life and loss.
Exit from sound balance defines what destructive action does to that domain.
Movement through the land turns earth into a field that must be encountered and read.
The ground beneath travel supplies the material archive of creation.
Directed sight and insight make observation of the earth an epistemic practice.
Bringing a thing into being connects the visible first creation to a later emergence.
Measured formation gives the heavens and earth an ordered construction.
Stable correspondence with reality makes truth the medium of that construction.
Delivered water supplies the material input by which the earth is renewed.
Earth-life through rain and growth makes renewal visible rather than metaphorically empty.
The productive land image receives revival and closes the loop back to the focus ground.

changed_reading.after: Earth is a truth-built, readable, revivable substrate, so corrupting it damages both a life process and the evidence through which later creation is apprehended.
changed_reading.before: Earth is simply the geographical place where corruption occurs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth becomes an inspectable record of first and later creation, a measured truth-built domain, and a recipient revived by delivered water. The focus prohibition therefore concerns damage to a living sign-bearing substrate, not misconduct in an inert container.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies observation, ordered creation, truth, water, and revival; I infer that corruption is misalignment with and injury to a sign-bearing life process. A live alternative is that earth functions only as evidence for resurrection, not as an ecological patient of the focus prohibition.
structural_cues: 29:20 commands movement in the earth and observation of how creation began before naming the later creation.
29:44 states that the heavens and earth were created in truth.
29:63 describes water descending and earth being revived after death.

activation_trace.role: Kinship anchors the model in the focus speaker's durable inside relation.
Affection supplies the social adhesive that can hold a false allegiance together in the present.
Expulsion under anger shows that the same social arrangement can reverse into mutual distancing.
Loving protective alliance supplies the relation whose capacity to bear weight is tested.
Shelter and dwelling turn allegiance into a support structure rather than a private opinion.
Loss of strength diagnoses the structure formed by misplaced protection.
Twisted contention supplies the relational pressure that must be handled without severing the addressee.
What is fair rather than ugly constrains the manner of corrective speech.
Divine oneness supplies the common load-bearing allegiance toward which relation is redirected.

changed_reading.after: Brotherly correction is a bid to preserve and rebuild social support around a durable allegiance before present affection becomes a fragile shelter and eventual mutual expulsion.
changed_reading.before: "Their brother" is mainly a credential of ethnic proximity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Present affection can stabilize false worship yet reverse into expulsion; protective alliances can build only a weak shelter. The focus brotherly address, later constrained by the best mode of disagreement and a shared one-God confession, offers a different support architecture: relation is preserved by reorienting allegiance rather than flattering the existing bond.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affection, reversal, weak shelter, constrained dispute, and divine unity; I infer that social bonds operate as support architecture and that the focus kin address attempts to rebuild it. A live alternative is that the three passages concern separate phenomena: idolatrous affection, unreliable protection, and intercommunal etiquette.
structural_cues: 29:25 locates mutual affection around false objects in present life and mutual repudiation on the resurrection day.
29:41 compares protectors besides God to a weak house.
29:46 joins the best mode of disputation to the confession that both communities' deity is one.

activation_trace.role: Ground as the lower support anchors the reversal in the focus domain.
Loss of sound balance names the destabilizing practice against which the reversal operates.
The repeated corrupter label places the focus warning inside an already active destruction sequence.
An effect remaining after departure supplies the residue-to-sign mechanism.
Severe shaking converts corruption's lost balance into a bodily and terrestrial event.
Adhering to the ground and remaining in place turns formerly active agents into immobile residue.

changed_reading.after: The clause warns against a trajectory in which agents who unbalance their inhabited ground become a ground-bound residue that later observers must read.
changed_reading.before: The land clause identifies only where the people's corruption happens.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior corrupting people is followed by an intelligible trace left behind; immediately after the focus warning, rejection is followed by violent instability and bodies stuck to the ground in their dwelling. This produces a material reversal: those warned not to destabilize life in the earth are themselves destabilized by the ground and reduced to fixed residue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sequential warnings, a surviving trace, severe shaking, and ground-adhesion; I supply the reversal from destabilizing earthly order to being destabilized and immobilized by earth. The live alternative is a simpler punishment sequence with no reciprocal material symbolism.
structural_cues: 29:35 closes the preceding warning sequence with a clear sign left for people who reason.
29:36 issues the focus warning, and 29:37 immediately answers rejection with shaking and fixed bodies in their dwelling.

activation_trace.role: Departure from sound order anchors the model in the focus diagnosis.
Making deeds appear beautiful supplies corruption's self-concealing surface.
Turning away and diverting converts attractive deeds into path-blocking force.
Heart-insight keeps the model from reducing wrongdoing to simple ignorance.
Self-magnification supplies the posture by which agents occupy the earth without accepting limit.
Grounded earth repeats the focus arena and makes arrogance spatially operative.
Earth sinking supplies a material collapse beneath asserted greatness.
Putting a thing outside its proper place makes wrongdoing a misordering that returns upon the actor.
The very self identifies the eventual patient of the agents' outward misordering.

changed_reading.after: Corrupters may be clear-sighted operators inside an attractive, status-enhancing order whose path-blocking misplacement ultimately degrades their own selves.
changed_reading.before: Corrupters are visibly disorderly people who fail to see what they are doing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Corruption need not appear chaotic to its agents: deeds can be beautified, the path blocked, and insight retained, while arrogance expands through the earth. The consequence catalogue then says people wronged their own selves, including through the earth's subsidence. The focus participle thus includes polished, self-justifying systems that redirect sight and motion against their bearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beautification, obstruction, insight, spatial arrogance, collapse, and self-wrong; I infer a feedback loop in which an attractive order degrades the agents who maintain it. The live alternative is that beautification explains disbelief but not the focus land-corruption specifically.
structural_cues: 29:38 joins beautified deeds, obstruction of the path, and retained insight.
29:39 locates arrogance in the earth and denies escape.
29:40 catalogs distinct material ends before stating that the people wronged themselves.

activation_trace.role: Humble worship anchors the later practice in the focus imperative.
Loss of sound order is the outward behavior that practiced restraint must interrupt.
Specified worship supplies the repeated embodied practice rather than bare assent.
Checking and restraining action supplies the causal link from worship to conduct.
Crossing limit and measure identifies one behavior the practice is to inhibit.
Recognizably ugly action supplies the socially legible wrong that is to be repelled.
Keeping something present after possible forgetfulness sustains the inhibitory relation.

changed_reading.after: "Worship God" also names a practiced restraint system capable of preventing the corruptive mode prohibited at the verse's end.
changed_reading.before: "Worship God" names the correct object of devotion before an independent ethical prohibition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Prayer is named as a repeated worship practice that actively inhibits boundary-crossing ugliness and recognized wrong, while remembrance keeps the governing relation present. This supplies an internal control mechanism between the focus commands: worship trains the restraint required by "do not".
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, repeated prayer, inhibition, limit-crossing, and remembrance; I infer a training loop from allegiance through recollection to restraint. A live alternative is that prayer's inhibition concerns only the two named wrongs and should not be generalized to the focus's land-corruption.
structural_cues: 29:36 places worship before the negative imperative against corruptive action.
29:45 explicitly predicates behavioral restraint of established prayer and then magnifies remembrance of God.

activation_trace.role: Heartfelt expectation anchors patience in the focus command rather than in indifference.
Deferral to a later time supplies the apparent delay whose meaning is revised.
Hurrying and bringing forward expose impatience with the unseen schedule.
A fixed temporal limit makes delay scheduled rather than empty.
Sudden surprise removes perceived delay as a reliable margin for continued misconduct.
Physical enclosure removes an imagined outside from which consequence can be watched safely.
A covering that spreads over all gives the account total vertical reach.

changed_reading.after: Hope is patient vigilance toward a fixed but undisclosed moment whose sudden, enclosing reach leaves no safe interval or location for corruption.
changed_reading.before: Hoping for a later day risks making that day feel remote.

context_deltas.mechanism: Demands to hurry punishment are answered by a fixed term, surprise arrival, enclosure, and an event covering from above and below. The focus hope is thus patient without being vague: delay is not absence, and no spatial margin lies outside the eventual account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impatience, fixed timing, surprise, enclosure, and vertical coverage; I infer that hope disciplines the false inference from delay to impunity. A live alternative is that hope and the punishment-timing exchange address different audiences and should not be coupled.
structural_cues: 29:53 repeats the demand for haste, names an appointed term, and says the event comes suddenly without perception.
29:54-55 move from surrounding enclosure to coverage from above and beneath the feet.

activation_trace.role: Shared ground anchors both the prohibition and the later alternatives of movement and refuge.
Loss of sound order is the local practice that spatial freedom may allow one to refuse.
Repeated humble worship identifies the allegiance that remains portable across place.
Divine earth supplies a field larger than the immediate corrupt environment.
Spaciousness against constriction opens practical room for continued worship.
A bounded protected precinct supplies localized safety within the wider earth.
Heart-security and trust connect experienced safety with the demanded believing response.
Swift seizure outside the precinct shows the contingency of spatial security.
The surrounding sides define the contrast between a protected center and exposed environs.

changed_reading.after: The earth is a wider divine field in which allegiance can move and safety is bounded gift, so neither local pressure nor local immunity excuses a corrupt order.
changed_reading.before: "In the earth" fixes the people within the territory where they must behave better.

context_deltas.mechanism: God's earth is declared spacious enough for worship, while a protected precinct is shown as secure amid people being seized around it. The focus's "in the earth" therefore does not trap obedience inside one local order, and local safety cannot be mistaken for autonomous immunity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spacious earth, portable worship, bounded sanctuary, and danger around it; I infer that movement can be an ethical refusal and safety a gift requiring right attribution. The live alternative is that migration and sanctuary gratitude are separate spatial teachings with no direct bearing on the focus prohibition.
structural_cues: 29:56 places the breadth of God's earth between belief and the renewed command to worship God alone.
29:67 contrasts a made-secure precinct with people being seized around it and asks about belief and ingratitude.

activation_trace.role: Heartfelt hope anchors the revaluation of present and later life.
Life as benefit and good gives the later dwelling substantive vitality rather than mere duration.
Being occupied by one thing away from another explains how the nearer life displaces the governing horizon.
Action lacking a sound end diagnoses present conduct severed from lasting purpose.
The later horizon identifies where genuine life is located.
Exclusive purification from partnership shows devotion temporarily cleared under danger.
Obedience and submission identify the purified orientation that fails to persist after rescue.

changed_reading.after: Hope identifies enduring life as the true end and keeps devotion coherent across danger and safety, preventing ordinary life from becoming purposeless corruptive play.
changed_reading.before: Hope for the Last Day adds a future reward or punishment to present worship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later dwelling is named as life itself, while the nearer life can distract and become action without a true end. The ship sequence then shows devotion purified under danger but mixed again after rescue. Focus hope is therefore a stable orientation toward enduring life that must govern ordinary safety, not a crisis response or a license to play until later.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displacement, purposeless action, enduring life, crisis-purity, and post-rescue reversal; I infer that the focus hope demands cross-situation consistency. A live alternative is that the life contrast and ship scene remain independent critiques of distraction and association.
structural_cues: 29:64 contrasts the nearer life as diversion and play with the later dwelling as life.
29:65 contrasts exclusive devotion during danger with renewed association upon reaching land.

activation_trace.role: Ground as the field of human movement anchors the concluding paths in the focus spatial clause.
Departure from sound order marks the negative trajectory that guided motion reverses.
Exerting full capacity under difficulty supplies directed human effort.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the answering directional force.
Extended traversable paths give the redirected motion concrete channels.
Doing what is good identifies the social quality accompanying guided movement.

changed_reading.after: The stop-command clears destructive motion so effort can be rechanneled into guided, traversable paths marked by good action and divine accompaniment.
changed_reading.before: "Do not ta'thaw in the earth" is primarily a stop-command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The conclusion supplies a positive motion-pattern opposite the focus's branchless destructive roaming: effort directed toward God is met by gentle direction into extended paths and divine accompaniment of those who do good. The focus prohibition becomes not a command to stop moving, but to exchange unbounded damaging motion for purposive, guided traversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibited destructive movement and a final effort-to-guidance sequence; I infer a directional reversal rather than simple immobility. The live alternative is that the conclusion concerns spiritual striving generally and does not specify the physical or social motion prohibited in the focus.
structural_cues: The focus negates the branchless verb ta'thaw while retaining the spatial phrase "in the earth."
29:69 closes the surah with human striving, divine guidance, plural paths, and divine accompaniment.

remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrows from provision pressure to corruption and from corrupted ground to ground-reversal are reader inferences; the packet also permits parallel exhortation and punishment readings.
The focus root ع ث و has no branch inventory, so its precise motion-image remains structural rather than branch-resolved.
The social-house synthesis and the spatial migration-security synthesis combine passages that may remain independent.
The five outliers are intentionally contained branch activations and should not displace the ordinary lexical readings.
strongest_changes: The Last Day becomes an arriving, assaying, nontransferable account rather than a remote doctrine.
Worship becomes a provision-and-trust regime and a practiced restraint mechanism, not only correct cultic allegiance.
Earth becomes a truth-built, readable, revivable substrate whose loss of balance can return materially upon its corrupters.
The immediate 29:35-37 sequence turns the warning into a trajectory from ignored sign through severe shaking to ground-bound residue.
The final striving-guidance-path sequence supplies purposive motion as the positive reversal of destructive movement.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly joined the focus's relational, temporal, and spatial clauses without collapsing them: kinship became support architecture, hope became deadline and durable life-orientation, worship became dependence and inhibition, and earth became evidence, patient, route, and responsive ground.

activation_trace.role: A tether or fastening loop recasts kinship as a bond that can hold a community near correction.
Shelter supplies the social structure within which the tether would have to bear.
Structural weakness explains why an internal fastening relation matters.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the brother functions like a relational tether: an internal bond trying to hold a weakening communal house close enough to be repaired.
changed_reading.before: The brother designation identifies shared descent or familiarity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus noun ordinarily presents kinship, not hardware; it remains anchored in the packet's tether branch for the same focus root and is activated by the later weak-house image. Render it only as a material analogy for relational responsibility, never as a replacement gloss for "brother."
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word "their brother" at focus word 3.

activation_trace.role: The wood-eating earth-creature supplies an image of support being consumed quietly from within.
A wound spoiled by accumulating matter supplies a second slow process of internal degradation.
Exit from soundness turns both material images into models of corruption.
Hidden creeping supplies the low-visibility propagation mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also includes low-visibility processes that consume supports or infect a wound until loss of soundness becomes visible.
changed_reading.before: Corruption in the earth is overt rampage and public disorder.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because earth is normally the affected place, not a wood-eating creature or suppurating wound, and the later creature need not denote hidden motion in context. It remains valid as an anchored process analogy supported by the focus earth and corruption roots plus the packet's hidden-creeping branch. Downstream prose should mark it as a possibility that expands corruption beyond spectacular disorder.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired focus words "earth" and "corrupters" at words 15-16.

activation_trace.role: A road made level and tractable images worship as preparing conduct for sustained passage.
Gentle direction toward a road supplies the guide that can use the prepared surface.
Extended traversable paths supply the destination of the road-making analogy.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, worship also surfaces and levels the actor's conduct so guidance can become a repeatedly traversed path.
changed_reading.before: Worship is an act performed before one chooses a moral path.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus imperative plainly commands worship, whereas the branch image concerns a leveled, traversable road. It remains anchored in the focus worship-root and gains a visible mechanism from the final guidance-and-path sequence. Render it as a material analogy for what worship does to conduct, not as an alternative translation.

activation_trace.role: Valuation and pricing recast communal standing as partly governed by what and how the group values.
A flourishing market supplies the exploratory image of collective prosperity whose moral basis is at issue.
Increase and abundance provide one condition under which communal valuations operate.
Apportioned provision contests the premise that value is wholly self-generated.
Restriction to a narrow measure provides the contrasting condition of scarcity.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the address also calls the community's valuation regime to account: what makes collective life or exchange stand must be recalibrated by worship, eventual account, and provision as allotment.
changed_reading.before: "O my people" only identifies the audience.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because "my people" is the literal focus sense and the value-pricing and flourishing-market branches are remote members of its inventory. It remains anchored in that exact focus root and is activated by the later expansion, restriction, and allotment of provision. Render it as a pun-like diagnostic of communal valuation, not as evidence that the focus explicitly mentions a market.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The vocative "O my people" at focus word 6.

activation_trace.role: Open pasture and animals released without a keeper supply the shadow of present conduct left unmanaged.
Mixture and disorder supply the result when deferral becomes lack of present governance.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies the opposite of unmanaged release.
Traversable paths channel motion that would otherwise disperse.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, true future hope is distinguished from letting present affairs roam unattended: its horizon channels conduct now rather than deferring its governance.
changed_reading.before: Hope is simply positive expectation of the future.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant activation because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped root for the focus hope-root, with images of unattended pasture and mixed disorder. It remains worth carrying because it directly contrasts the focus hope command with the adjacent corruption prohibition and the final guided paths. Render it only as the rejected shadow against which hope is disciplined, never as the lexical meaning of the imperative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative "hope" at focus word 9, immediately before the prohibition on destructive action.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Corruption as a spreading medium.** ع ث و B001 is “corruption spreading in the land.” Worship and hope for the last day establish vertical orientation, while the prohibition describes فساد moving horizontally through the earth. I infer that unbounded conduct propagates through shared space rather than remaining private; the ayah reads hope and worship as restraints on ecological-social spread.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:40 makes land, air, and water answer human corruption, while 29:56 calls the same earth spacious for worship. Earth is not passive backdrop: it can transmit فساد, consequence, or escape-room.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Brotherly address makes correction an internal bond before conflict.** Lexical evidence: `أَخَاهُم`, root `ء خ و`, `B001` (brotherhood and kinship); `قَوْم`, root `ق و م`, `B001` (group of people); and `ٱعْبُدُوا`, root `ع ب د`, `B003` (worship and submissive obedience). Structural cue: Shuʿayb is introduced through kinship and then addresses “my people,” after `29:31-33` tested household and settlement belonging. Assigned role: brotherhood makes the warning arise from within the social unit; worship redirects that unit's governing allegiance. Abductive move: the packet does not say kinship causes receptivity; I infer that it removes the excuse that correction comes from an unrelated outsider. Reading change: the call is a repair attempt internal to communal belonging.

2. **Future hope is meant to halt corruption spreading through land.** Lexical evidence: `ٱرْجُوا`, root `ر ج و`, `B001` (expectant hope); `ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْآخِر`, roots `ي و م B003` (event-day or severe occasion) and `ء خ ر B001` (later); `تَعْثَوْا`, root `ع ث و`, `B001` (corruption spreading in the land); and `مُفْسِدِين`, root `ف س د`, `B001` (departure from balance). Structural cue: hope for the later event is coordinated with a prohibition on present land-spread; `29:37-40` answer denial with shaking dwellings and multiple earth-bound consequences. Assigned role: future expectation supplies temporal restraint; the two corruption roots identify spatial diffusion and systemic imbalance. Abductive move: I infer that hope blocks spread by making present action answerable to the later event. Reading change: eschatological hope becomes an anti-corruption control on present ecology and society.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later activation (`29:64`):** The distinction between distracting near-life and the truly living later abode deepens Shuʿayb's `ٱرْجُوا ٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلْآخِر`. Hope restrains corruption because it prevents the near horizon from monopolizing attention, valuation, and the imagined duration of consequences.

words.gloss_range: resumptive coordination opening a new prophet-cycle while binding it to the preceding narrative
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens as a bound resumption into another prophet-cycle, so the ayah continues the prophet-narrative chain rather than resetting the scene. Its single-letter form keeps coordination and resumption together, carrying the preserved sign of 29:35 into a new sending scene and preparing the move from divine narration to prophetic speech.

The preposition carries both direction and purposive endpoint, and the fronted destination phrase compresses the known sending formula found with Shuayb’s mission scenes (7:85; 11:84; 29:36).

words.gloss_range: proper place-name as destination complement; root pressure may evoke obligation and judgment without replacing the toponym
words.prose: {{ar:مَدْيَنَ}} ({{tr:madyana}}) names the mission destination as a diptote proper place-name governed after the preceding preposition; it is not the sent object or a common noun. The settlement-and-people range survives under the toponym, while obligation-and-judgment pressure from {{ar:د ي ن}} ({{tr:d-y-n}}) remains a resonance. The name also reopens the Madyan-Shuayb pattern after the ruin-sign of 29:35, with recurrence across 7:85, 11:84, and 29:36.

words.prose: {{ar:أَخَاهُمْ}} ({{tr:akhāhum}}) introduces the messenger by relation before the appositional name. The kinship word makes Shuayb an insider-prophet rather than a literal sibling, and it participates in the brother-plus-name commissioning formula.

words.gloss_range: proper name in apposition to their brother, locally identifying the insider-prophet
